notes: DuckStation (PlayStation): the upstream AppImage, mounted; its real binary is run, never AppRun.
-batch quits when the game closes, so OpenGamepadUI gets the panel back instead of DuckStation's own UI; -- ends options in case a ROM name starts with '-'.
gui_args (Main menu > Emulators > Open): Big Picture is the pad-driven UI (the desktop one needs a mouse); no -batch, which would quit at once with no game.
